hints.pause:
Stop scheduled runs until you resume.
A run in progress, with its retries, finishes. Run now still works.
hints.resume:
Restart the schedule at its next time after now.
Times missed while paused are skipped; resuming does not run it now.
hints.run_now:
Run it once now, without waiting for the schedule.
The schedule does not move: the next scheduled run keeps its time, or starts right after this run if its time comes first.
Does not count toward a run limit. Works while paused; it stays paused.
Not available while a run is in progress.
hints.stop_current:
Cancel the run in progress, or its pending retry.
It ends as cancelled, with no failure notice. The schedule continues.
hints.revise:
Change the task, schedule or settings.
Changes apply from the next run; a run in progress keeps its inputs. A changed schedule restarts from now, so no past time runs.
hints.archive:
Stop it for good: it will not run again.
A run in progress finishes; the history stays readable.
hints.discuss:
Talk about the results in a separate conversation, seeded with the runs up to this one.
It has its own workspace (the automation's files are read-only) and never changes the automation.

run_now_growing_line: Growing context: later runs see this run in their history.
run_now_one_line: Run it once now, without waiting for the schedule; the next scheduled run keeps its time.
